name: Soybean Board Crush Spread Analysis
description: Analyzes the soybean board crush spread using ZS (Soybeans), ZM (Soybean Meal), and ZL (Soybean Oil) futures. The crush spread measures the gross processing margin (GPM) for soybean processors: Board Crush ($/bu) = (ZM × 0.022) + (ZL × 0.11) - (ZS × 0.01). Panel 1 shows the crush spread level over time with 20-day SMA and dual-color area fill (green above 3-year mean, red below), plus a summary table with current crush, 3-yr stats, percentile rank, and oil/meal share percentages. Panel 2 shows the oil and meal value contributions in dollar terms and their percentage share over time to reveal structural shifts in processing margin composition.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN BOARD CRUSH SPREAD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Crush spread = (ZM × 0.022) + (ZL × 0.11) - (ZS × 0.01)  ($/bushel)
# ZS: cents/bushel, ZM: $/short ton, ZL: cents/pound
# Conversion: 44 lbs meal / 2000 lbs/ton = 0.022, 11 lbs oil / 100 cents/$ = 0.11
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
# ZS (primary asset)
zs_src = market_data_source()()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zs_src.o, zs_src.h, zs_src.l, zs_src.c, zs_src.v, zs_src.oi, zs_src.s)
zs_close = zs_cont.c

# ZM (Soybean Meal) via reference_futures
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZM")()
zm_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zm_ref.o, zm_ref.h, zm_ref.l, zm_ref.c, zm_ref.v, zm_ref.oi, zm_ref.s)
zm_close = zm_cont.c

# ZL (Soybean Oil) via reference_futures
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZL")()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zl_ref.o, zl_ref.h, zl_ref.l, zl_ref.c, zl_ref.v, zl_ref.oi, zl_ref.s)
zl_close = zl_cont.c

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# Per-bushel values in dollars
soybean_cost = zs_close * 0.01
meal_value = zm_close * 0.022
oil_value = zl_close * 0.11

# Board crush spread ($/bu)
crush = meal_value + oil_value - soybean_cost

# 20-day SMA of crush
crush_sma = ma(period=20)(crush)

# 3-year mean of crush (approx 756 trading days)
crush_3yr_mean = ma(period=756)(crush)

# Percentile rank over 3-year window
crush_pctrank = percentrank(period=756)(crush)

# --- Oil / Meal Split ---
total_product = meal_value + oil_value
oil_share_pct = (oil_value / total_product) * 100
meal_share_pct = (meal_value / total_product) * 100

# --- Panel 1: Crush Spread Level ---
# Dual-color area fill: green when above 3yr mean, red when below
crush_diff = crush - crush_3yr_mean
crush_abs = abs(crush_diff)
crush_pos = (crush_diff + crush_abs) / 2 + crush_3yr_mean
crush_neg = crush_3yr_mean - (crush_abs - crush_diff) / 2

# Actually, we want: when crush > mean, show crush in green area; when crush < mean, show in red
# Using the reference template pattern for split:
# spread_pos = positive part of (crush - mean), spread_neg = negative part
spread_above = (crush_diff + crush_abs) / 2
spread_below = (crush_diff - crush_abs) / 2

bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Board Crush Spread ($/bushel)',
    category='1. Crush Spread Level',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Crush Spread ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero Line")
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Above 3-Yr Mean', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Below 3-Yr Mean', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d SMA', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, spread_above, spread_below, crush_sma)

# 3-year stats for summary table
crush_3yr_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(crush)
crush_3yr_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(crush)

# Summary table: current crush, 3yr avg, 3yr high, 3yr low, percentile, oil share, meal share
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=7,
        col_headers=['Current Crush ($/bu)', '3-Yr Average', '3-Yr High', '3-Yr Low', 'Percentile Rank', 'Oil Share %', 'Meal Share %'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Crush Spread Level',
    order=1
)(crush, crush_3yr_mean, crush_3yr_max, crush_3yr_min, crush_pctrank, oil_share_pct, meal_share_pct)

# --- Panel 2: Oil/Meal Split Over Time ---
# Dollar contribution lines
xy_lines(
    title='Product Value Contribution per Bushel ($/bu)',
    category='2. Oil/Meal Split',
    y_axis_label='Value ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Value (ZM × 0.022)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Value (ZL × 0.11)', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, meal_value, oil_value)

# Percentage share lines
xy_lines(
    title='Oil vs Meal Share of Product Value (%)',
    category='2. Oil/Meal Split',
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    y_axis_label='Share of Product Value (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Share %', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Share %', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, meal_share_pct, oil_share_pct)
